name: Mana
description: You have 1 level-1 Pact Magic spell slot. Expend it to cast a prepared level-1 spell. You regain all expended mana after a Short or Long Rest.

name: Magical Cunning
description: Perform a rite for 1 minute to recover expended Pact Magic slots, up to half your maximum (round up). At Warlock levels 2 and 3, recover one slot. Regain this use after a Long Rest.
